entries.reason: Soft restart walks every registered IStateProvider via forEach so game state resets without clearing ResourceManager.

requires.fallback: empty forEach set: soft restart still reloads scripts / calls eve_init; no native providers reset

trim.absent_profile: devtools soft-restart remains available; IStateProvider listeners may be empty when modules are trimmed

entries.thread_affinity: main / MCP poll thread that owns the VM; forEach is not cross-thread
